summary: Iteration 20: Full backend+frontend testing of 4 new features (dynamic leaderboard, per-user daily targets, 401 session-expiry interceptor, forgot/reset-password flow). Backend: 8/8 pytest tests passing. Frontend: all critical Playwright flows passing (Grace login, leaderboard with 5 entries + (You) badge, EditProfile modal with all 8 new data-testid fields, session-expiry interceptor redirects+toast+localStorage clear, wrong-password does NOT trigger expiry toast, forgot-password 3-step flow with pre-filled token, copy button, invalid-token error, successful reset + old-pw 401 + new-pw 200). Grace's password and profile goals were restored to defaults after testing.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend response envelope is FLAT (e.g. login returns {token, user} at top level, not wrapped in {data: ...}). Prior test fixtures in system prompt template assumed a 'data' key; adjusted accordingly. Consistent, but worth documenting in API docs.
POST /api/v1/auth/reset-password expects body field 'newPassword' (camelCase) while some ecosystems expect 'password'. Not a bug, but worth surfacing in API contract.
GET /api/v1/user/profile confirmed to omit passwordHash, resetPasswordToken, resetPasswordExpires — good security.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 TEST_ prefixed users (TEST_leader_* and TEST_reset_*) during backend tests; each test also creates independent TEST_ users. These persist in DB. Main agent may run `cd /app/server && npx ts-node src/seed.ts` to purge if desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 features verified. Backend uses flat JSON responses (no 'data' envelope). reset-password body key is 'newPassword'. Grace's profile+password were restored via API after testing. Some TEST_ users remain from registration-based tests (leaderboard-new-user and forgot/reset flow); safe to reseed.
